_comment: Reference/source-of-truth for the gPAS domain hierarchy seeded by services/gpas/sqls_pg/03_init_gpas_domain.sql. This file documents the hierarchy; it is not parsed by scripts/init_gpas_domains.sh (the actual INSERTs live in the SQL file) - it exists so the shape of the domain tree has one readable place to check/update alongside the SQL.

domains.name: spe.direct
domains.label: Direct Identifiers
domains.description: Direct identifying values that should always be pseudonymized before downstream processing.

children.name: spe.direct.resource-id
children.label: Logical Resource IDs
children.description: FHIR Resource.id values across Bundle members and standalone resources.

children.name: spe.direct.patient-admin
children.label: Patient Administrative IDs
children.description: MRN, SSN, national IDs, passport numbers, local patient identifiers.

children.name: spe.direct.person-name
children.label: Person Names
children.description: Human names for Patient, Practitioner, RelatedPerson, Person, contact names and free-text extracted names.

children.name: spe.direct.contact
children.label: Contact Channels
children.description: Phone numbers, emails, telecom values, endpoint addresses, URLs where pseudonymization rather than hard redaction is required.

children.name: spe.direct.address
children.label: Addresses and Locations
children.description: Street lines, city, district, postal code, free-form address text, location names and aliases.

children.name: spe.direct.document-media
children.label: Documents, Images and Media
children.description: Attachment titles, document labels, base64 payload references, device serials, UDI values, photos.

domains.name: spe.quasi
domains.label: Quasi Identifiers
domains.description: Values that are not direct identifiers alone but can enable re-identification in combination.

children.name: spe.quasi.demographic
children.label: Demographics
children.description: Birth year/date, death dates, gender, marital status, communication language, birthplace, ethnicity, race.

children.name: spe.quasi.clinical-time
children.label: Clinical Timeline
children.description: onset, abatement, effectiveDateTime, issued, recordedDate, occurrence and other event timing fields.

children.name: spe.quasi.special-category
children.label: Special Category Attributes
children.description: Nationality, religion, political affiliation/opinion and other Art. 9 style sensitive attributes.

domains.name: spe.clinical
domains.label: Clinical Content
domains.description: Clinical data families where different pseudonymization policies may be needed for text, values and references.

children.name: spe.clinical.observation
children.label: Observations and Measurements
children.description: Observation value sets, reference ranges, component values and related note text.

children.name: spe.clinical.condition-procedure
children.label: Conditions and Procedures
children.description: Condition onset/abatement, Procedure.performed, ClinicalImpression, FamilyMemberHistory and related narrative fields.

children.name: spe.clinical.report-text
children.label: Reports and Narrative Text
children.description: Narrative.div, notes, DiagnosticReport conclusions, care instructions, comments and other free-text clinical fields.

domains.name: spe.operational
domains.label: Operational and Administrative Workflow
domains.description: Scheduling, communication, practitioner and organization related operational identifiers and text.

children.name: spe.operational.org-practitioner
children.label: Organizations and Practitioners
children.description: Organization, OrganizationAffiliation, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, RelatedPerson, Person and Endpoint related identifiers.

children.name: spe.operational.scheduling
children.label: Scheduling and Requests
children.description: Appointment, Schedule, Slot, Task, ServiceRequest, RequestGroup and Communication request payloads.

domains.name: spe.financial
domains.label: Coverage, Claims and Billing
domains.description: Insurance, claims and account identifiers where separate tenant or legal controls often apply.

children.name: spe.financial.coverage
children.label: Coverage and Eligibility
children.description: Coverage.subscriberId, dependent, class values, network, eligibility request and response identifiers.

children.name: spe.financial.claims
children.label: Claims, EOB and Payments
children.description: Claim, ClaimResponse, ExplanationOfBenefit, Invoice, PaymentReconciliation, Account and ChargeItem identifiers and notes.

domains.name: spe.technical
domains.label: Technical Metadata and Linkage
domains.description: Transport and linkage metadata that should be isolated from clinical and administrative pseudonym domains.

children.name: spe.technical.references
children.label: FHIR References and URLs
children.description: Bundle fullUrl, request.url, response.location, Reference.reference and endpoint/location URLs.

children.name: spe.technical.extensions
children.label: Extensions and Custom Payloads
children.description: Custom extensions, coded displays, expression text and implementation-specific metadata.

domains.name: TESTING
domains.label: TESTING
domains.description: Default pseudonymisation domain. Change GPAS_DOMAIN in .env to use an spe.* domain instead.
